nations.name: Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes
nations.lands: Western Oklahoma, United States; headquarters in Concho

facts.text: The Council page attributes exclusive approval of the annual Tribal budget to the Tribal Council under the 2006 Constitution.
facts.evidence: Exclusive power to approve the annual budget

facts.text: The Tribes’ Records Management Office dates its establishment to 2010 and describes preserving and maintaining Tribal records.
facts.evidence: Established in 2010, the Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes

facts.text: The Tribal Tribune reports that the Tribes signed a Geary land-into-trust agreement with the Bureau of Indian Affairs on June 4, 2020.

source.title: Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes Governor signs first successful land into trust agreement

facts.evidence: signed an agreement with the Bureau

facts.text: The Tribes’ July 3, 2024 release reports 93.43 acres at El Reno placed into trust, with the deed and acceptance of conveyance signed July 2.

source.title: Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes Finalize Historic Land-Into-Trust Transfer
